Evidence:
[1] The station was formerly called Ekbatan (Eram-e Sabz), however the "Ekbatan" part of the name was dropped on July 2015, in order to avoid confusion with the nearby Shahrak-e Ekbatan Metro Station, as part of the city council's consideration of polling of the public opinions.
[2] Massimiliano Fuksas (born January 9, 1944) is an international Italian architect.
[3] Designed by the Italian architect Massimiliano Fuksas, the station is primarily located in a central roundabout in Corso Umberto I (Rettifilo), with secondary entrances along Via Marina and Via Duomo.
